items.title: WordPress核心升级期远程代码执行
items.title_zh: WordPress核心升级期远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可在核心升级窗口访问可预测暂存路径并执行代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: WordPress(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 立即升级至修复版本；升级窗口限制访问并清理暂存
items.repro_note: 升级窗口期访问可预测暂存路径，构造包触发执行
items.description: WordPress Core is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in versions 4.7 through 7.1.3. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window.

items.title: 未知组件签名校验缺陷可伪造通过
items.title_zh: 未知组件签名校验缺陷可伪造通过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可篡改sign参数使签名校验失效，伪造数据通过验证
items.action_zh: 定位受影响组件，升级修复并强制验签
items.repro_note: 篡改sign参数提交，验证签名校验是否被绕过
items.impact_scope: 影响面不明，涉及签名可信链
items.description: Such manipulation of the argument sign leads to improper verification of cryptographic signature. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG栈溢出远程触发
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者构造请求触发栈溢出，可致设备崩溃或执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级固件；无法升级时限制管理界面访问
items.repro_note: 向设备Web接口构造超长参数触发栈溢出
items.impact_scope: 家用/小型办公路由器，管理面暴露
items.description: A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. This affects the function setAppEasyWizardConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component Easy Setup Wizard Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument functionType can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG无线配置栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者在无线配置接口提交超长wepkey，触发栈溢出
items.action_zh: 升级固件；限制cstecgi.cgi管理接口访问
items.impact_scope: TOTOLINK路由器，管理面可能暴露
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. This impacts the function strcpy of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component Basic Wireless Configuration Handler. The manipulation of the argument wepkey leads to stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG多SSID溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者经多SSID配置的wepkey2/wepkey3提交超长值触发溢出
items.action_zh: 升级固件；禁用多SSID或限制管理访问
items.impact_scope: TOTOLINK路由器，管理面可能暴露
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected is the function setWiFiMultipleConfig/delWiFiMultipleConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component Multi-SSID Configuration. The manipulation of the argument wepkey2/wepkey3 results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG MAC过滤溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向MAC过滤接口的addEffect传超长值，触发栈溢出
items.action_zh: 升级固件；限制管理接口并关闭外网访问
items.impact_scope: TOTOLINK路由器，管理面可能暴露
items.description: A flaw has been found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this vulnerability is the function setMacFilterRules of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component MAC Filter Handler. This manipulation of the argument addEffect causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: Etrel充电桩管理Web默认凭据
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者使用出厂默认账号登录，获得充电站管理员权限
items.action_zh: 升级至7.1.2/8.0.1并立即修改默认口令
items.repro_note: 用出厂默认账号登录管理Web，验证管理员权限
items.impact_scope: 电动汽车充电桩管理面，可能联网
items.description: Etrel INCH AC charging station management web interface prior to firmware versions 7.1.2 and 8.0.1 contains a hard-coded default credentials vulnerability that allows remote attackers to gain full Administrator access by authenticating with the factory-default account. Attackers can log in over cleartext HTTP to obtain complete charger configuration, OCPP ChargePoint Identity, and CSMS WebSocket connection details, enabling unauthorized administrative control of the charging station.

items.title: Emerson Ovation协议无认证
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可访问无认证协议篡改控制器配置或造成拒绝服务
items.action_zh: 隔离控制网络，升级并按厂商加固协议
items.repro_note: 接入控制网络访问无认证协议端口，尝试改配置
items.impact_scope: 工业控制系统控制器，生产网络内
items.description: Emerson Ovation has several protocols that have no authentication, which could allow an attacker to change controller configuration or cause a denial-of-service condition.

items.title: NoMachine堆溢出可远程执行代码
items.title_zh: NoMachine堆溢出可远程执行代码
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者利用堆溢出在服务账户上下文执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级NoMachine至修复版本，限制服务端口暴露
items.repro_note: 向NoMachine服务发送特制请求触发堆溢出
items.impact_scope: 远程桌面服务，常暴露内网/公网
items.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NoMachine. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.

items.title: Quest Foglight缺失认证RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者利用缺失认证访问服务，以SYSTEM权限执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级Foglight修复版本，限制管理端口访问
items.repro_note: 未授权访问Foglight管理服务并构造请求执行代码
items.impact_scope: 数据库监控平台，内网高权限
items.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Quest Foglight for Databases. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.

items.title: Quest Foglight路径处理RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用路径处理缺陷绕过限制，以SYSTEM权限执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级Foglight修复版本，限制管理端口访问
items.repro_note: 构造路径参数触发文件操作，验证代码执行
items.impact_scope: 数据库监控平台，内网高权限
items.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Quest Foglight for Databases. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.

items.title: Quest Foglight反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向baseRmiServiceExporter提交恶意序列化数据，执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级Foglight修复版本，限制RMI服务访问
items.repro_note: 向baseRmiServiceExporter发送恶意序列化载荷
items.impact_scope: 数据库监控平台，内网高权限
items.description: Quest Foglight for Databases baseRmiServiceExporter Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Quest Foglight for Databases.
